statement: The iterated odd-landing sets P_r occupy shrinking arithmetic cylinders, or iteration is recognized modulo 2^m, or successive square-gap coordinates on long odd runs are constrained. Counterexamples: on odd n≤8000 the stay fraction |P_{r+1}|/|P_r| is 0.49–0.53 through r=7; P_r is mostly isolated odds; every residue modulo 64 both continues and exits; θ on P_r and on the exit from P_{r-1} both occupy [0,1].

Write oddLanding y for y odd and T(y) odd, and oddRun 0 y = oddLanding y, oddRun (r+1) y = oddLanding y and oddRun r (T(y)). Then oddRun (r+1) y if and only if y is odd and oddRun r (T(y)). The odd-landing cylinder of a fixed m contains at most one integer.
